FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 342
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility Sponsor: Representative Susan DuBose
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/10/2026
House Bill 342 as introduced authorizes the state to participate in the federal tax credit
established for scholarship granting organizations, which could increase the administrative
obligations of the Department of Revenue to annually publish and submit to the U.S. Secretary a
list of the qualified scholarship granting organizations. This bill would not otherwise directly
affect state or local funding.
